sloka: प्रगृहीताः प्रकाशन्ते सूर्यस्य इव मरीचयः ।पृथिव्याम् च अनुकृष्यन्ते हरो नाम एष यूथपः ॥६-२७-३॥।।
transliteration: pragṛhītāḥ prakāśante sūryasya iva marīcayaḥ ।pṛthivyām ca anukṛṣyante haro nāma eṣa yūthapaḥ ॥6-27-3॥।।

translations.english: "One who is of terrific action, whose long tail with plenty of hair of different colours like red, white, yellow with shining ends shining like the scattered rays of the rising sun is holding and dragging on the ground is a leader known as Hara."
translations.hindi: और जो सूर्य की किरणों की तरह चमक रहे हें और जो पूंछ भटकारने से खड़े हो जाते और जो चलते समय भूमि पर लथिरते जाते हैं, सो वही हर नास यूथपति हं
